ai-commit-fast.name: Lightweight commit
ai-commit-fast.cmd: opencode run "/lightweight-commit" "Please create a lightweight commit for the currently staged changes" -m "opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash" && opencode export $(opencode session list --max-count 1 --format json | jq -r '.[].id') | jq -r '.info as $i | .messages[-1].info as $m | "\($m.modelID) • \($m.providerID) • \((($i.time.updated-$i.time.created)/1000)|floor)s • \($m.tokens.total) tokens (\($m.tokens.input)i+\($m.tokens.output)o+\($m.tokens.reasoning)r, cache \($m.tokens.cache.read)r/\($m.tokens.cache.write)w) • $\( $m.cost )"'

ai-commit.name: Lightweight commit (choose model)
ai-commit.description: Run lightweight commit and pick model via placeholder
ai-commit.cmd: opencode run "/lightweight-commit" "Please create a lightweight commit for the currently staged changes" -m $(echo ${model} | cut -d: -f1) $(echo ${model} | grep -q: && echo --variant $(echo ${model} | cut -d: -f2)) && opencode export $(opencode session list --max-count 1 --format json | jq -r '.[].id') | jq -r '.info as $i | .messages[-1].info as $m | "\($m.modelID) • \($m.providerID) • \((($i.time.updated-$i.time.created)/1000)|floor)s • \($m.tokens.total) tokens (\($m.tokens.input)i+\($m.tokens.output)o+\($m.tokens.reasoning)r, cache \($m.tokens.cache.read)r/\($m.tokens.cache.write)w) • $\( $m.cost )"'
